"""Explicit isolated full Java build of one committed node revision. No SSH or deployment."""
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import argparse
import datetime
import hashlib
import io
import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import tarfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import common as p


def build(revision):
    p.require(re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{40}', revision), 'Full committed node revision required')
    head = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=p.WORKSPACE, text=True).strip()
    p.require(head == revision, 'HEAD/explicit source revision changed before build')
    out = p.OUT / 'tool-validation'; out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    destination = p.BASE / ('build-' + revision)
    source_path = p.BASE / ('source-' + revision + '.tar')
    for path in (destination, source_path, p.BASE / 'build.json', out / 'java-build.log', out / 'java-tests.json'):
        p.require(not path.exists(), 'Build evidence/checkout already exists; inspect without overwrite: ' + str(path))
    paths = ['core', 'cluster', 'server', 'projector', 'bench', 'gradle', 'gradlew', 'gradlew.bat',
             'build.gradle.kts', 'settings.gradle.kts', 'gradle.properties', 'deploy', 'scripts']
    archive_command = ['git', 'archive', '--format=tar', revision, '--', *paths]
    raw = subprocess.check_output(archive_command, cwd=p.WORKSPACE)
    with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(raw), mode='r:') as source:
        members = source.getmembers()
        p.require(source.pax_headers.get('comment') == revision, 'git archive commit metadata differs')
        p.require(len({entry.name for entry in members}) == len(members), 'Duplicate source archive member')
        for entry in members:
            name = PurePosixPath(entry.name)
            p.require(not name.is_absolute() and '..' not in name.parts and (entry.isdir() or entry.isfile()), 'Unsafe source archive member')
        destination.mkdir()
        source.extractall(destination)
    with source_path.open('xb') as stream: stream.write(raw)
    info = {'revision': revision, 'root': str(destination), 'source': 'git archive of committed source/build/tool files only',
            'sourceRevisionExplicitlyPinned': True, 'sourceArchiveSha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
            'sourceArchivePath': str(source_path), 'sourceArchiveCommand': archive_command}
    p.save_new(p.BASE / 'build.json', info)
    environment = dict(os.environ)
    environment.update({'JAVA_HOME': str(p.WORKSPACE / '.tools/jdk'),
                        'GRADLE_USER_HOME': str(p.WORKSPACE / '.tools/gradle-user-home'),
                        'VM_TEST_PG_URL': 'jdbc:postgresql://127.0.0.1:55432/postgres?user=vectormatch'})
    environment['PATH'] = str(p.WORKSPACE / '.tools/gradle/bin') + ':' + str(p.WORKSPACE / '.tools/jdk/bin') + ':' + environment['PATH']
    command = ['gradle', '--no-daemon', 'test', ':cluster:installDist']
    started = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
    print('ISOLATED_NODE_IDLE_BUILD_STARTED', revision, flush=True)
    with (out / 'java-build.log').open('x') as log:
        result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=destination, env=environment, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    suites = []
    for file in sorted(destination.glob('*/build/test-results/test/TEST-*.xml')):
        suite = ET.parse(file).getroot()
        suites.append({'suite': suite.attrib['name'], **{key: int(suite.attrib.get(key, 0)) for key in ('tests', 'failures', 'errors', 'skipped')}})
        target = out / 'java-xml' / file.parent.parent.parent.parent.name / file.name
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with target.open('xb') as stream: stream.write(file.read_bytes())
    receipt = {**info, 'startedAt': started, 'completedAt': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
               'command': command, 'exitCode': result.returncode, 'suites': suites,
               'tests': sum(row['tests'] for row in suites), 'failures': sum(row['failures'] + row['errors'] for row in suites),
               'skipped': sum(row['skipped'] for row in suites),
               'scope': 'Full isolated committed-source Java tests and installDist only; no capacity prerequisite, SSH, deployment, registration or load.'}
    p.save_new(out / 'java-tests.json', receipt)
    print(json.dumps({key: value for key, value in receipt.items() if key != 'suites'}), flush=True)
    print((out / 'java-build.log').read_text()[-4500:], flush=True)
    return result.returncode


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--revision', required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--execute', action='store_true')
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if not args.execute:
        print(json.dumps({'draftOnly': True, 'buildExecuted': False, 'sshOrDeployment': False, 'revision': args.revision}))
        return 0
    return build(args.revision)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""Node-only idle experiment preparation. Importing never registers or contacts a node."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import re
import sys

BASE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
WORKSPACE = BASE.parents[3]
EVIDENCE = WORKSPACE / 'evidence/2026-10-23/runpod-optimization'
OUT = EVIDENCE / 'idle'
CAPACITY_BASE = BASE.parent / 'pipeline-capacity'
CAPACITY_ROOT = EVIDENCE / 'pipeline-capacity'
LOAD_REVISION = 'e57e341909a49692b9ecbf9693803ed62a240b06'
LOAD_BUNDLE = 'f7f1c3868e0f588d7598c1464bf70229ebe2b8e3b5c67874783acabc00206937'
ANALYSIS_IDENTITY = '31e4dbc7af8c6e84e6099b76081837716870c47d4811d6d0db1757d594707e1f'
ANALYSIS_REVISION = '3fd86fe535fc0858e300e0337d4da154f622ae32'
PARK_ENV = 'VECTOR_DATA_PATH_MAX_PARK_NS'
CONTROLLERS = ('common.py', 'register.py', 'matrix.py', 'test_guards.py', 'build.py', 'bundle-node.py', 'deploy-node.py')
PHASE = 'node-only-data-path-max-park-control'
_CAPACITY = None


def require(value, message):
    if not value: raise ValueError(message)


def digest(path):
    path = Path(path); require(path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink(), 'Regular input required: ' + str(path))
    result = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        while block := stream.read(1024 * 1024): result.update(block)
    return result.hexdigest()


def read(path):
    digest(path); return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())


def save_new(path, value):
    path = Path(path); path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with path.open('x') as stream: json.dump(value, stream, indent=2); stream.write('\n')


def capacity_module():
    global _CAPACITY
    if _CAPACITY is None:
        plan = read(CAPACITY_ROOT / 'plan.json')
        for name, expected in plan['controllerSha256'].items():
            require(digest(CAPACITY_BASE / name) == expected, 'Registered capacity controller changed: ' + name)
        sys.path.insert(0, str(CAPACITY_BASE))
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('idle_frozen_capacity', CAPACITY_BASE / 'common.py')
        module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); sys.modules[spec.name] = module; spec.loader.exec_module(module)
        _CAPACITY = module
    return _CAPACITY


def tasks(kind):
    if kind == 'pilot':
        return [{'id': 'i-pilot-park100000-10000-w128', 'cohort': 'pilot', 'rate': 10000,
                 'arrivals': 350000, 'workers': 128, 'transportMode': 'multiplexed', 'maxParkNs': 100000,
                 'phase': 'node-idle-strict350k-canonical-pilot', 'repetition': 1}]
    require(kind == 'matrix', 'Unknown idle plan kind')
    return [{'id': f'i-park{park}-26000-w128-r{rep}', 'cohort': f'park{park}', 'rate': 26000,
             'arrivals': 350000, 'workers': 128, 'transportMode': 'multiplexed', 'maxParkNs': park,
             'phase': PHASE, 'repetition': rep}
            for rep in (1, 2) for park in (1000000, 100000)]


def fixed_configuration(source, park):
    require(type(park) is int and park in (1000000, 100000), 'Only preregistered node park values allowed')
    fixed = {**source, 'clientTransportMode': 'multiplexed', 'clientSessionCount': 1,
             'nodeDataPathMaxParkNs': park, 'nodeDataPathIdlePolicyVersion': 1,
             'nodeDataPathIdleAgentMaxYields': 20, 'nodeDataPathIdleMinParkNs': 1000,
             'driverIdleMaxParkNs': park}
    fixed['idleStrategy'] = ('Independent node data-path Backoff: driver(10,5,1000,' + str(park)
                             + '), archive/consensus/service(10,20,1000,' + str(park) + '); load policy unchanged')
    return fixed


def strict_pilot(result, load):
    require(result.get('passed') is True and result.get('canonicalSnapshotBytesVerified') is True
            and result.get('measurementValid') is True and load.get('generatorTimingInvalid') is False,
            'Pilot must be canonical and timing-valid')
    require(load.get('scheduledArrivals') == load.get('confirmedAcceptedCommands') == 350000,
            'Strict pilot must accept all350k arrivals')
    for name in ('clientNotSentCommands', 'businessRejectedCommands', 'serverErrors', 'unknownAtInitialDeadline',
                 'unresolvedFinal', 'schedulerLatenessAboveLimitCount'):
        require(type(load.get(name)) is int and load[name] == 0, 'Strict pilot nonzero/missing count: ' + name)


def prerequisites():
    """The complete earlier18k matrix is a hard local-only registration gate."""
    p = capacity_module(); plan_path = CAPACITY_ROOT / 'plan.json'; plan = read(plan_path)
    require(plan['rate'] == 18000 and plan['trials'] == p.tasks(18000), 'Require original unmodified18k A/B/A/B capacity plan')
    identity = p.validate_plan(plan); c = p.frozen_parent(); prepared = plan['preparedSnapshotSha256']
    require(plan['analysisIdentitySha256'] == ANALYSIS_IDENTITY and plan['postprocessor']['revision'] == ANALYSIS_REVISION,
            'Only the separately validated31e4 streaming postprocessor is allowed')
    require(identity['node']['revision'] == LOAD_REVISION and identity['node']['bundleSha256'] == LOAD_BUNDLE
            and identity['node'] == identity['load'], 'Earlier capacity node/load source changed')
    inputs = {}
    def remember(path): inputs[str(Path(path).relative_to(WORKSPACE))] = digest(path)
    for path in [plan_path, CAPACITY_ROOT / 'timeline.jsonl', CAPACITY_ROOT / 'tool-validation/postprocessor-identity.json']:
        remember(path)
    retained = []
    for task in plan['trials']:
        directory = CAPACITY_ROOT / task['cohort'] / 'runs' / task['id']
        checked = c.checked_trial(CAPACITY_ROOT, task, identity, prepared)
        analysis = p.check_trial_analysis(directory, plan['postprocessor'])
        trial = read(directory / 'trial.json'); c.checked_stop_receipt(directory / 'all-owned-processes-stopped.json', trial['state'])
        row = next(row for row in read(CAPACITY_ROOT / task['cohort'] / 'analysis/summary.json')['trials'] if row['id'] == task['id'])
        for name in row['inputSha256']: remember(directory / name)
        for name in ['configuration-verification.json', 'receipt.json', 'arrivals.csv.gz', 'arrivals-archive.json',
                     'postprocess.json', 'postprocessor-identity.json', 'analysis-summary.json', 'analysis-capacity.csv',
                     'all-owned-processes-stopped.json']:
            remember(directory / name)
        remember(CAPACITY_ROOT / task['cohort'] / 'analysis/summary.json')
        retained.append({**checked, 'state': trial['state'], 'analysisVerification': analysis})
    events = [json.loads(line) for line in (CAPACITY_ROOT / 'timeline.jsonl').read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]
    completed = [event for event in events if event.get('action') == 'pipeline-capacity-matrix-completed']
    require(len(completed) == 1 and [row['id'] for row in completed[0].get('trials', [])] == [t['id'] for t in plan['trials']],
            'Complete18k matrix timeline missing or changed')
    return {'preparedSnapshotSha256': prepared, 'loadIdentity': identity['load'], 'loadBuild': identity['build'],
            'priorNodeBuildTools': identity['buildTools'], 'observer': identity['observer'], 'probe': identity['probe'],
            'postprocessor': plan['postprocessor'], 'analysisIdentitySha256': plan['analysisIdentitySha256'],
            'retainedCapacityAttempts': retained, 'completionEvent': completed[0], 'inputs': dict(sorted(inputs.items())),
            'scope': 'Complete frozen earlier18k A/B/A/B, including terminal invalid attempts, configuration/leader/raw/archive/analysis and explicit owned cleanup. No earlier failure is reclassified.'}


def artifact_inputs(prior, require_upload=True):
    """Root supplies reviewed build/release/upload receipts; this function never builds or deploys."""
    p = capacity_module(); c = p.frozen_parent()
    node = read(BASE / 'node-release.json'); build = read(BASE / 'build.json')
    require(node['revision'] != LOAD_REVISION and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{40}', node['revision']), 'Require one separate full node commit')
    require(build['revision'] == node['revision'] and build.get('sourceRevisionExplicitlyPinned') is True
            and build.get('sourceArchiveSha256'), 'New node build source not explicitly pinned')
    build_root = Path(build['root']).resolve()
    require(build_root.parent == BASE and build_root.name == 'build-' + node['revision'], 'Unexpected isolated node build path')
    manifest = c.archive_manifest(node)
    require(read(OUT / 'node-deployment-manifest.json') == manifest and manifest['comparedAgainstNodeRevision'] == LOAD_REVISION,
            'New node archive/byte-comparison manifest differs')
    changed = manifest.get('changedClusterEntries', [])
    allowed = lambda name: name == 'io/vectormatch/cluster/ClusterNodeMain.class' or name.startswith('io/vectormatch/cluster/ClusterNodeMain$')
    require(changed and all(allowed(name) for name in changed),
            'Only NodeMain/its idle-policy nested class may change from e57')
    actual_diff = node_class_diff(c, node, prior['loadIdentity'])
    require(actual_diff['changedClusterEntries'] == sorted(changed), 'Manifest class-diff declaration differs from archive bytes')
    test = read(OUT / 'tool-validation/java-tests.json')
    require(test['revision'] == node['revision'] and test['exitCode'] == 0 and test['failures'] == 0
            and test['skipped'] == 0 and test['tests'] > 0, 'New isolated node build/test not green')
    tools = {}
    for name in ('scripts/check-capacity-leader.py', 'scripts/verify-capacity-config.py',
                 'scripts/analyze-capacity.py', 'scripts/archive-capacity-arrivals.py'):
        path = build_root / name; tools[name] = {'path': str(path), 'sha256': digest(path)}
        if name != 'scripts/verify-capacity-config.py':
            require(tools[name]['sha256'] == prior['priorNodeBuildTools'][name]['sha256'], 'Unrelated tool changed: ' + name)
    if require_upload:
        uploaded = read(OUT / 'node-upload-receipt.json')
        require(uploaded['bundleSha256'] == node['bundleSha256'] and len(uploaded['nodes']) == 3
                and {row['node'] for row in uploaded['nodes']} == {0, 1, 2}, 'Three-node immutable upload receipt missing')
        require(all(row['verified'] and row['nodeRevision'] == node['revision'] and row['files'] == manifest['files']
                    and row['launcherTest']['exitCode'] == 0 for row in uploaded['nodes']), 'Node upload/launcher validation failed')
    return {'node': node, 'load': prior['loadIdentity'], 'loadBuild': prior['loadBuild'], 'build': build, 'buildTools': tools,
            'observer': prior['observer'], 'probe': prior['probe'], 'postprocessor': prior['postprocessor'],
            'analysisIdentitySha256': prior['analysisIdentitySha256'], 'nodeClassDiffAudit': actual_diff}


def artifact_prerequisites():
    """Local artifact-only gate: cap18 need only be registered, not completed."""
    p = capacity_module(); plan = read(CAPACITY_ROOT / 'plan.json')
    require(plan['rate'] == 18000 and plan['trials'] == p.tasks(18000), 'Require unchanged registered18k plan')
    identity = p.validate_plan(plan)
    require(identity['load']['revision'] == LOAD_REVISION and identity['load']['bundleSha256'] == LOAD_BUNDLE
            and plan['analysisIdentitySha256'] == ANALYSIS_IDENTITY, 'Fixed load/analysis identity changed')
    return {'loadIdentity': identity['load'], 'loadBuild': identity['build'], 'priorNodeBuildTools': identity['buildTools'],
            'observer': identity['observer'], 'probe': identity['probe'], 'postprocessor': plan['postprocessor'],
            'analysisIdentitySha256': plan['analysisIdentitySha256']}


def node_class_diff(c, node, load):
    """Compare all immutable JAR entry bytes; outer ZIP timestamps are not code changes."""
    import io
    import tarfile
    import zipfile
    c.archive_manifest(load)
    def jars(release):
        output = {}
        with tarfile.open(release['archive']) as archive:
            for member in archive.getmembers():
                if member.isfile() and member.name.startswith('dist/cluster/lib/') and member.name.endswith('.jar'):
                    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(archive.extractfile(member).read())) as jar:
                        output[Path(member.name).name] = {name: hashlib.sha256(jar.read(name)).hexdigest()
                                                        for name in jar.namelist() if not name.endswith('/')}
        return output
    before, after = jars(load), jars(node)
    require(before and set(before) == set(after), 'Node/load dependency JAR filename sets differ')
    changes = []
    for name in before:
        if not name.startswith('cluster-'):
            require(before[name] == after[name], 'Unrelated dependency/core JAR entries changed: ' + name)
            continue
        for entry in sorted(set(before[name]) | set(after[name])):
            if before[name].get(entry) == after[name].get(entry): continue
            require(entry == 'io/vectormatch/cluster/ClusterNodeMain.class'
                    or entry.startswith('io/vectormatch/cluster/ClusterNodeMain$'), 'Unrelated cluster entry changed: ' + entry)
            changes.append(entry)
    require(changes, 'No new node-only idle bytecode found')
    return {'changedClusterEntries': sorted(changes), 'otherJarEntriesUnchanged': True,
            'scope': 'All named JAR entry bytes compared with fixed e57 load archive; outer ZIP timestamp/packaging metadata is excluded.'}


def configure(c, identity, park):
    require(park in (1000000, 100000), 'Unknown node-only max park')
    c.RELEASE = identity['node']['root']; c.LOAD_RELEASE = identity['load']['root']
    c.BUILD_TOOLS = identity['buildTools']; c.ATTRIBUTION_ROOT = identity['observer']['root']; c.SOCKET_PROBE = identity['probe']
    c.COMMON.update({'VECTOR_DIST_ROOT': c.RELEASE + '/dist', 'VECTOR_MAX_CLUSTER_SESSIONS': '256', 'VECTOR_MAX_HEAP': '2g',
                     'VECTOR_OUTBOX_CAPACITY': '800000', 'VECTOR_STATE_PROFILE': 'capacity-350k-v1',
                     'VECTOR_SOCKET_RECEIVE_BUFFER_BYTES': '131072', 'VECTOR_DRIVER_THREADING_MODE': 'SHARED',
                     'VECTOR_NAK_UNICAST_DELAY_NS': '1000'})
    c.COMMON.pop(PARK_ENV, None)  # The load environment/driver remains unchanged.
    c.LOAD_JVM_ARGUMENTS = ['-Dvectormatch.capacity.client.driver=shared', '-Daeron.nak.unicast.delay=1000',
                            '-Dvectormatch.capacity.client.transport=multiplexed']
    c.LOAD_IDENTITY = {'loadGeneratorRevision': identity['load']['revision'],
                       'loadGeneratorBundleSha256': identity['load']['bundleSha256'], 'loadGeneratorRelease': c.LOAD_RELEASE,
                       'attributionObserverIdentity': identity['observer']['identity'], 'effectiveBufferProbeSha256': identity['probe']['sha256']}
    original = getattr(c, 'idle_original_service', c.service); c.idle_original_service = original
    c.service = lambda node, role, action, env: original(node, role, action, {**env, PARK_ENV: str(park)} if role == 'node' else env)


def checked_trial(task, identity, prepared):
    p = capacity_module(); c = p.frozen_parent(); directory = OUT / task['cohort'] / 'runs' / task['id']
    checked = c.checked_trial(OUT, task, identity, prepared)
    analysis = p.check_trial_analysis(directory, identity['postprocessor'])
    trial = read(directory / 'trial.json'); fixed = trial['fixedNodeConfiguration']
    require(fixed['nodeDataPathMaxParkNs'] == fixed['driverIdleMaxParkNs'] == task['maxParkNs'], 'Actual node park differs')
    require(fixed['nodeDataPathIdlePolicyVersion'] == 1 and fixed['nodeDataPathIdleAgentMaxYields'] == 20
            and fixed['nodeDataPathIdleMinParkNs'] == 1000, 'Idle policy semantics differ')
    require(trial['loadGeneratorRevision'] == LOAD_REVISION and trial['loadGeneratorBundleSha256'] == LOAD_BUNDLE,
            'Load source changed from fixed e57 multiplexed path')
    c.checked_stop_receipt(directory / 'all-owned-processes-stopped.json', trial['state'])
    return {**checked, 'maxParkNs': task['maxParkNs'], 'analysisVerification': analysis}


def controller_hashes():
    return {name: digest(BASE / name) for name in CONTROLLERS}


def fresh_owned_stopped(c, identity, states):
    # Reuse the frozen complete-owned-record validator without its historical
    # configure(direct) call changing this experiment's fixed multiplexed setup.
    class ReadOnlyAdapter:
        def configure(self, supplied, mode): pass
        def __getattr__(self, name): return getattr(c, name)
    return capacity_module().fresh_owned_stopped(ReadOnlyAdapter(), identity, states)


def validate_plan(plan):
    prior = prerequisites(); require(prior == plan['prerequisites'], 'Earlier capacity evidence changed')
    identity = artifact_inputs(prior)
    require(all(plan[name] == value for name, value in identity.items()), 'Artifact/load/observer/analysis identity changed')
    require(plan['trials'] == tasks(plan['kind']) and plan['controllerSha256'] == controller_hashes(), 'Task/controller changed')
    require(plan['loadWholeProcessTimeoutSeconds'] == plan['validationTimeoutSeconds'] == 600
            and plan['noHiddenReissue'] is True and plan['requireAllOwnedProcessesStoppedBeforeNextTrial'] is True,
            'Timeout/no-replay policy changed')
    if plan['kind'] == 'matrix':
        pilot_plan = read(OUT / 'pilot-plan.json')
        require(digest(OUT / 'pilot-plan.json') == plan['pilotPrerequisite']['planSha256'], 'Pilot plan changed')
        require(all(pilot_plan[name] == value for name, value in identity.items()), 'Pilot artifact differs from formal')
        pilot = tasks('pilot')[0]; row = checked_trial(pilot, identity, prior['preparedSnapshotSha256'])
        strict_pilot(read(OUT / pilot['cohort'] / 'runs' / pilot['id'] / 'result.json'),
                     read(OUT / pilot['cohort'] / 'runs' / pilot['id'] / 'load-result.json'))
        require(row == plan['pilotPrerequisite']['trial'], 'Strict pilot evidence changed')
        for name, expected in plan['pilotPrerequisite']['proofs'].items():
            relative = Path(name)
            require(not relative.is_absolute() and '..' not in relative.parts and digest(OUT / relative) == expected,
                    'Pinned strict pilot proof changed: ' + name)
    return identity


def run_task(task, plan, identity):
    p = capacity_module(); c = p.frozen_parent()
    c.validate_identity = validate_plan
    c.configure = lambda supplied, mode: configure(c, supplied, task['maxParkNs']) if mode == 'multiplexed' else require(False, 'Only fixed multiplexed load is allowed')
    c.analyze_and_archive = lambda supplied, node_identity: p.analyze_and_archive(c, supplied, node_identity, identity['postprocessor'])
    result = c.run_task(OUT, task, plan, identity, plan['preparedSnapshotSha256'])
    checked = checked_trial(task, identity, plan['preparedSnapshotSha256'])
    if plan['kind'] == 'pilot':
        directory = OUT / task['cohort'] / 'runs' / task['id']
        strict_pilot(read(directory / 'result.json'), read(directory / 'load-result.json'))
    return checked

"""Explicit transfer/hash/Linux launcher tests only; never starts/stops nodes or load."""
import argparse
import json
import shlex
import common as p

REMOTE_VERIFY = '''import pathlib,hashlib,tarfile,json,subprocess,sys
base=pathlib.Path(RELEASE)
manifest=base/'DEPLOYMENT.json'
if not manifest.exists():
 assert {path.name for path in base.iterdir()} <= {'bundle.tar.gz.part'}
 part=base/'bundle.tar.gz.part';assert part.is_file() and not part.is_symlink() and hashlib.sha256(part.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==EXPECTED
 with tarfile.open(part) as archive:
  members=archive.getmembers();assert len(members)==len({m.name for m in members})
  for member in members:
   name=pathlib.PurePosixPath(member.name);assert not name.is_absolute() and '..' not in name.parts and (member.isfile() or member.isdir())
  archive.extractall(base)
 part.replace(base/'bundle.tar.gz')
assert hashlib.sha256((base/'bundle.tar.gz').read_bytes()).hexdigest()==EXPECTED
observed=json.loads(manifest.read_text());assert observed==MANIFEST
for name,expected in observed['files'].items():
 path=base/name;assert path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink() and hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected
result=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-B','-m','unittest','discover','-s',str(base/'deploy'),'-p','test_remote_service.py'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=40)
print(json.dumps({'verified':result.returncode==0,'nodeRevision':observed['revision'],'files':observed['files'],
 'launcherTest':{'exitCode':result.returncode,'stdout':result.stdout,'stderr':result.stderr},
 'scope':'Immutable release bytes and Linux launcher unit tests only; no JVM, node/load/gateway/PG service or kernel change.'}))
raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
'''


def deploy():
    prior = p.artifact_prerequisites(); identity = p.artifact_inputs(prior, require_upload=False)
    node = identity['node']; c = p.capacity_module().frozen_parent(); manifest = c.archive_manifest(node)
    target = p.OUT / 'node-upload-receipt.json'; p.require(not target.exists(), 'Upload receipt already exists; inspect exact release, no overwrite')
    def one(member):
        release = node['root']
        p.require(release == '/opt/vectormatch/optimization-node-releases/' + node['revision'], 'Unexpected immutable release path')
        result = c.remote.run(member, 'mkdir -p ' + shlex.quote(release)); p.require(result.returncode == 0, 'Cannot create separate release directory')
        inspect = 'import pathlib,json\np=pathlib.Path(' + repr(release) + ')\nprint(json.dumps({"manifestPresent":(p/"DEPLOYMENT.json").exists()}))'
        existing = json.loads(c.py(member, inspect, 20))
        if not existing['manifestPresent']:
            transfer = c.remote.upload(member, node['archive'], release + '/bundle.tar.gz.part')
            p.require(transfer.returncode == 0, 'Node bundle transfer failed')
        code = 'RELEASE=' + repr(release) + '\nEXPECTED=' + repr(node['bundleSha256']) + '\nMANIFEST=' + repr(manifest) + '\n' + REMOTE_VERIFY
        row = json.loads(c.py(member, code, 65)); row['node'] = member; return row
    rows = c.parallel(one)
    p.require(len(rows) == 3 and {row['node'] for row in rows} == {0,1,2} and all(row['verified'] for row in rows), 'Immutable transfer/launcher tests failed')
    p.save_new(target, {'timestamp': c.now(), 'bundleSha256': node['bundleSha256'], 'nodes': rows,
                        'loadArtifactUnchanged': prior['loadIdentity'],
                        'scope': 'Upload separate commit-named node release and Linux launcher tests only. No service/node/load/Pod lifecycle action or kernel setting.'})
    print('IMMUTABLE_NODE_IDLE_UPLOAD_VERIFIED_NO_PROCESS_START', node['revision'], flush=True)


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__); parser.add_argument('--execute', action='store_true'); args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if not args.execute:
        print(json.dumps({'draftOnly': True, 'sshOrDeploymentExecuted': False})); return
    deploy()


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Explicit registered idle job runner. Importing submits nothing."""
import argparse
import shutil
import common as p


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--kind', choices=('pilot', 'matrix'), default='matrix')
    parser.add_argument('--execute', action='store_true')
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    p.require(args.execute, 'Root must separately review and explicitly --execute')
    plan = p.read(p.OUT / ('pilot-plan.json' if args.kind == 'pilot' else 'plan.json'))
    p.require(plan['kind'] == args.kind, 'Registered kind differs')
    identity = p.validate_plan(plan); capacity = p.capacity_module(); c = capacity.frozen_parent()
    c.budget(900 if args.kind == 'pilot' else 3000)
    p.require(shutil.disk_usage(p.OUT).free >= 1024 ** 3, 'At least1GiB free evidence space required')
    p.configure(c, identity, plan['trials'][0]['maxParkNs'])
    p.save_new(p.OUT / (args.kind + '-legacy-owned-stopped.json'), c.verify_historical_owned_stopped(identity))
    states = [row['state'] for row in plan['prerequisites']['retainedCapacityAttempts']]
    # Include the original26k formal states, omitted by the historical parent's legacy gate.
    prior_cap = p.read(p.CAPACITY_ROOT / 'plan.json')
    states += [row['state'] for row in prior_cap['prerequisites']['branch']['originalOutcomes']]
    if args.kind == 'matrix':
        task = p.tasks('pilot')[0]
        states.append(p.read(p.OUT / task['cohort'] / 'runs' / task['id'] / 'trial.json')['state'])
    p.save_new(p.OUT / (args.kind + '-capacity-owned-stopped.json'), p.fresh_owned_stopped(c, identity, states))
    results = []
    for task in plan['trials']:
        c.budget((len(plan['trials']) - len(results)) * 750)
        p.require(shutil.disk_usage(p.OUT).free >= 1024 ** 3, 'Full export local space guard failed')
        if results:
            previous = p.OUT / plan['trials'][len(results) - 1]['cohort'] / 'runs' / results[-1]['id']
            state = p.read(previous / 'trial.json')['state']
            p.save_new(p.OUT / ('before-' + task['id'] + '-owned-stopped.json'), p.fresh_owned_stopped(c, identity, [state]))
        results.append(p.run_task(task, plan, identity))
    c.OUT = p.OUT
    c.record('node-idle-' + args.kind + '-completed', trials=results, budget=c.budget(0),
             scope='All registered attempts retained with full raw archive and owned cleanup. Invalid/overload classifications stay unchanged.')
    print('NODE_IDLE_PLAN_COMPLETE_REVIEW_RESULTS', args.kind, flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Draft-only default. Root may explicitly --write after all frozen prerequisites exist."""
import argparse
import json
import common as p


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--kind', choices=('pilot', 'matrix'), default='matrix')
    parser.add_argument('--write', action='store_true')
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if not args.write:
        print(json.dumps({'draftOnly': True, 'noRegistrationOrSSHOrLoad': True, 'kind': args.kind,
                          'trials': p.tasks(args.kind), 'fixedLoad': 'e57 multiplexed1session/shared1driver/W128/Q64/NAK1000',
                          'required': 'Complete18k capacity4attempts/raw/archive/config/leader/analysis/cleanup/timeline; same new node artifact; strict B10k350k pilot before26kABAB.'}, indent=2))
        return
    prior = p.prerequisites(); identity = p.artifact_inputs(prior); capacity = p.capacity_module(); c = capacity.frozen_parent()
    name = 'pilot-plan.json' if args.kind == 'pilot' else 'plan.json'
    p.require(not (p.OUT / name).exists(), 'Plan exists; never overwrite/reissue exact IDs')
    pilot = None
    if args.kind == 'matrix':
        pilot_plan = p.read(p.OUT / 'pilot-plan.json')
        p.require(pilot_plan['kind'] == 'pilot' and all(pilot_plan[key] == value for key, value in identity.items()), 'Pilot/formal identity changed')
        task = p.tasks('pilot')[0]; row = p.checked_trial(task, identity, prior['preparedSnapshotSha256'])
        directory = p.OUT / task['cohort'] / 'runs' / task['id']
        p.strict_pilot(p.read(directory / 'result.json'), p.read(directory / 'load-result.json'))
        events = [json.loads(line) for line in (p.OUT / 'timeline.jsonl').read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]
        completed = [event for event in events if event.get('action') == 'node-idle-pilot-completed']
        p.require(len(completed) == 1 and [item['id'] for item in completed[0]['trials']] == [task['id']], 'Strict pilot completion timeline required')
        pilot = {'planSha256': p.digest(p.OUT / 'pilot-plan.json'), 'trial': row,
                 'resultSha256': p.digest(directory / 'result.json'), 'loadResultSha256': p.digest(directory / 'load-result.json'),
                 'proofs': {str((directory / name).relative_to(p.OUT)): p.digest(directory / name)
                            for name in ('trial.json', 'configuration.json', 'result.json', 'load-result.json',
                                         'fixed-leader-check.json', 'configuration-verification.json',
                                         'all-owned-processes-stopped.json', 'arrivals.csv.gz', 'arrivals-archive.json',
                                         'postprocess.json', 'postprocessor-identity.json', 'analysis-summary.json', 'analysis-capacity.csv')}}
    rows = p.tasks(args.kind)
    for task in rows: p.require(not (p.OUT / task['cohort']).exists(), 'Partial registration/trial exists; inspect without overwrite')
    budget = c.budget(900 if args.kind == 'pilot' else 3000)
    source = p.read(p.CAPACITY_ROOT / 'multiplexed/campaign.json')
    manifest = c.archive_manifest(identity['node'])
    for task in rows:
        cohort = p.OUT / task['cohort']
        if cohort.exists(): continue
        fixed = p.fixed_configuration(source['fixed'], task['maxParkNs'])
        campaign = {**source, 'registeredAtUtc': c.now(), 'fixed': fixed,
                    'screeningRates': [task['rate']], 'screeningWorkers': 128, 'concurrencySweep': [128],
                    'preparedSnapshotSha256': prior['preparedSnapshotSha256'], 'postprocessor': identity['postprocessor'],
                    'analysisIdentitySha256': identity['analysisIdentitySha256'], 'prerequisites': prior,
                    'scope': 'Node-only explicit max park control, A1000000 vsB100000. Same new node artifact; fixed e57 multiplexed load1session/logicalW128/Q64/shared1driver/NAK1000. Driver spin/yield10/5, archive/consensus/service10/20, min1000. All failed attempts retained; no combined-factor or sustained-engine capacity claim.'}
        p.save_new(cohort / 'campaign.json', campaign); p.save_new(cohort / 'deployment.json', identity['node'])
        p.save_new(cohort / 'deployment-manifest.json', manifest)
    p.save_new(p.OUT / name, {'registeredAtUtc': c.now(), 'kind': args.kind, **identity, 'prerequisites': prior,
                             'preparedSnapshotSha256': prior['preparedSnapshotSha256'], 'pilotPrerequisite': pilot,
                             'trials': rows, 'controllerSha256': p.controller_hashes(), 'budget': budget,
                             'loadWholeProcessTimeoutSeconds': 600, 'validationTimeoutSeconds': 600,
                             'localFreeBytesPerTrialMinimum': 1073741824, 'noHiddenReissue': True,
                             'requireAllOwnedProcessesStoppedBeforeNextTrial': True, 'newResources': 0,
                             'scope': 'Server-agent idle park factor only. Prior mux resource benefit motivates holding mux fixed in both arms, not attribution of stacked improvements to this one factor.'})
    print('NODE_IDLE_REGISTERED_NO_LOAD_SUBMITTED', args.kind, flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Local preparation tests; no real cloud/prerequisite/result scan."""
import contextlib
import hashlib
import io
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile
import tarfile
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch
import zipfile
import common as p
import register
import matrix


def pilot():
    return {'passed': True, 'canonicalSnapshotBytesVerified': True, 'measurementValid': True}, {
        'generatorTimingInvalid': False, 'scheduledArrivals': 350000, 'confirmedAcceptedCommands': 350000,
        'clientNotSentCommands': 0, 'businessRejectedCommands': 0, 'serverErrors': 0,
        'unknownAtInitialDeadline': 0, 'unresolvedFinal': 0, 'schedulerLatenessAboveLimitCount': 0}


def node_archive(path, changed=None):
    classes = {'io/vectormatch/cluster/ClusterNodeMain.class': b'old-node',
               'io/vectormatch/cluster/ClusterClient.class': b'fixed-e57-client'}
    classes.update(changed or {})
    payloads = {}
    for name, entries in [('cluster-0.jar', classes), ('core-0.jar', {'core.class': b'fixed-core'})]:
        data = io.BytesIO()
        with zipfile.ZipFile(data, 'w') as jar:
            for entry, blob in entries.items(): jar.writestr(entry, blob)
        payloads['dist/cluster/lib/' + name] = data.getvalue()
    with tarfile.open(path, 'w:gz') as archive:
        for name, data in payloads.items():
            member = tarfile.TarInfo(name); member.size = len(data); archive.addfile(member, io.BytesIO(data))
    return {'archive': str(path)}


class Guards(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_formal_order_is_one_node_factor_with_identical_mux_load(self):
        rows = p.tasks('matrix')
        self.assertEqual([1000000, 100000, 1000000, 100000], [row['maxParkNs'] for row in rows])
        self.assertEqual(4, len({row['id'] for row in rows}))
        self.assertTrue(all(row['transportMode'] == 'multiplexed' and row['workers'] == 128
                            and row['rate'] == 26000 and row['arrivals'] == 350000 for row in rows))
        self.assertNotIn('direct', {row['cohort'] for row in rows})

    def test_pilot_is_single_B_full350k_35second_point(self):
        rows = p.tasks('pilot'); self.assertEqual(1, len(rows)); row = rows[0]
        self.assertEqual(100000, row['maxParkNs']); self.assertEqual(35, row['arrivals'] / row['rate'])
        self.assertEqual('multiplexed', row['transportMode'])
        result, load = pilot(); p.strict_pilot(result, load)

    def test_pilot_rejects_initial_unknown_even_when_every_result_eventually_resolves(self):
        result, load = pilot(); load['unknownAtInitialDeadline'] = 1
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError): p.strict_pilot(result, load)

    def test_pilot_rejects_each_loss_rejection_error_timing_or_canonical_failure(self):
        for field in ['clientNotSentCommands', 'businessRejectedCommands', 'serverErrors', 'unresolvedFinal', 'schedulerLatenessAboveLimitCount']:
            result, load = pilot(); load[field] = 1
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError): p.strict_pilot(result, load)
        result, load = pilot(); load['confirmedAcceptedCommands'] = 349999
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError): p.strict_pilot(result, load)
        result, load = pilot(); load['generatorTimingInvalid'] = True
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError): p.strict_pilot(result, load)
        result, load = pilot(); result['canonicalSnapshotBytesVerified'] = False
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError): p.strict_pilot(result, load)

    def test_fixed_structured_policy_preserves_source_and_spin_yield_factors(self):
        source = {'driverIdleMaxSpins': 10, 'driverIdleMaxYields': 5, 'nodeHeap': '2g', 'syncLevel': 2,
                  'queuePerWorker': 64, 'nakUnicastDelayNs': 1000}
        before = dict(source)
        a, b = p.fixed_configuration(source, 1000000), p.fixed_configuration(source, 100000)
        self.assertEqual(before, source)
        self.assertEqual({'nodeDataPathMaxParkNs', 'driverIdleMaxParkNs', 'idleStrategy'},
                         {name for name in set(a) | set(b) if a.get(name) != b.get(name)})
        for value in [a, b]:
            self.assertEqual(20, value['nodeDataPathIdleAgentMaxYields']); self.assertEqual(5, value['driverIdleMaxYields'])
            self.assertEqual(1, value['clientSessionCount']); self.assertEqual('multiplexed', value['clientTransportMode'])

    def test_node_only_configure_never_puts_park_env_or_property_on_load(self):
        calls = []
        class Parent:
            COMMON = {'VECTOR_DATA_PATH_MAX_PARK_NS': 'stale'}
            def service(self, node, role, action, env): calls.append((node, role, action, env)); return 'stub'
        c = Parent()
        identity = {'node': {'root': '/new-node'}, 'load': {'root': '/fixed-e57', 'revision': p.LOAD_REVISION, 'bundleSha256': p.LOAD_BUNDLE},
                    'buildTools': {}, 'observer': {'root': '/fixed-observer', 'identity': 'observer'},
                    'probe': {'sha256': 'probe'}}
        p.configure(c, identity, 100000)
        self.assertNotIn(p.PARK_ENV, c.COMMON)
        self.assertEqual('/fixed-e57', c.LOAD_RELEASE); self.assertEqual('/new-node', c.RELEASE)
        self.assertEqual(['-Dvectormatch.capacity.client.driver=shared', '-Daeron.nak.unicast.delay=1000',
                          '-Dvectormatch.capacity.client.transport=multiplexed'], c.LOAD_JVM_ARGUMENTS)
        c.service(0, 'node', 'start', dict(c.COMMON)); self.assertEqual('100000', calls[-1][3][p.PARK_ENV])
        c.service(0, 'gateway', 'start', dict(c.COMMON)); self.assertNotIn(p.PARK_ENV, calls[-1][3])
        p.configure(c, identity, 1000000); c.service(0, 'node', 'start', dict(c.COMMON))
        self.assertEqual('1000000', calls[-1][3][p.PARK_ENV])

    def test_actual_archive_diff_allows_only_NodeMain_and_nested_idle_class(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
            root = Path(td); old = node_archive(root / 'old.tar.gz')
            new = node_archive(root / 'new.tar.gz', {'io/vectormatch/cluster/ClusterNodeMain.class': b'new-node',
                                                   'io/vectormatch/cluster/ClusterNodeMain$DataPathIdlePolicy.class': b'new-policy'})
            class Parent:
                def archive_manifest(self, release): return {}
            diff = p.node_class_diff(Parent(), new, old)
            self.assertEqual(2, len(diff['changedClusterEntries'])); self.assertTrue(diff['otherJarEntriesUnchanged'])

    def test_actual_archive_diff_rejects_even_one_changed_load_client_entry(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
            root = Path(td); old = node_archive(root / 'old.tar.gz')
            new = node_archive(root / 'new.tar.gz', {'io/vectormatch/cluster/ClusterNodeMain.class': b'new-node',
                                                   'io/vectormatch/cluster/ClusterClient.class': b'changed-client'})
            class Parent:
                def archive_manifest(self, release): return {}
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError): p.node_class_diff(Parent(), new, old)

    def test_draft_never_reads_incomplete_prior_matrix_or_writes_registration(self):
        with patch.object(p, 'prerequisites', side_effect=AssertionError('No prerequisite scan')), \
             patch.object(p, 'artifact_inputs', side_effect=AssertionError('No artifact scan')), \
             patch.object(p, 'save_new', side_effect=AssertionError('No registration')):
            output = io.StringIO()
            with contextlib.redirect_stdout(output): register.main([])
            self.assertTrue(json.loads(output.getvalue())['draftOnly'])

    def test_runner_without_execute_cannot_read_plan_or_connect(self):
        with patch.object(p, 'read', side_effect=AssertionError('No plan read')):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError): matrix.main([])

    def test_unknown_plan_kind_and_park_values_are_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError): p.tasks('unknown')
        for value in [0, 1000, 99999, True, '100000']:
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError): p.fixed_configuration({}, value)

    def test_exclusive_registration_and_hashes_preserve_existing_evidence(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
            path = Path(td) / 'receipt.json'; p.save_new(path, {'passed': False}); before = p.digest(path)
            with self.assertRaises(FileExistsError): p.save_new(path, {'passed': True})
            self.assertEqual(before, p.digest(path)); self.assertFalse(p.read(path)['passed'])

    def test_build_bundle_and_deploy_helpers_are_draft_only_without_execute(self):
        for name, function in [('build.py', 'build'), ('bundle-node.py', 'bundle'), ('deploy-node.py', 'deploy')]:
            spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('idle_helper_' + function, p.BASE / name)
            module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(module)
            with patch.object(module, function, side_effect=AssertionError('Explicit execution required')):
                output = io.StringIO()
                with contextlib.redirect_stdout(output):
                    module.main(['--revision', 'a' * 40] if function == 'build' else [])
                self.assertTrue(json.loads(output.getvalue())['draftOnly'])

    def test_remote_deploy_verification_program_compiles_without_service_lifecycle(self):
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('idle_helper_deploy_check', p.BASE / 'deploy-node.py')
        module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(module)
        compile(module.REMOTE_VERIFY, 'immutable-idle-release-verifier', 'exec')
        self.assertIn('test_remote_service.py', module.REMOTE_VERIFY)
        self.assertNotIn('ClusterNodeMain', module.REMOTE_VERIFY)
        self.assertNotIn('m.start(', module.REMOTE_VERIFY)
        self.assertNotIn('m.stop(', module.REMOTE_VERIFY)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main(verbosity=2)
